headline: Bitcoin tests key 78k resistance amid 1‑day pullback, liquidity hunt intensifies
btc_thesis: On the 1H chart BTC is forming a descending channel, holding above the 75.8k swing low while eyeing the 78.2k ceiling; 4H shows a retest of the 77.5k demand zone with sellers stepping in.
altcoin_summary: Capital is rotating into high‑beta alts as Bitcoin weakens, with top gainers RAY, SAGA and FF leading the short‑term rally.
strategy_outlook: Spot traders should consider buying near 75.8k support with tight stops; futures short‑bias above 78k with profit targets at 75.8k.
